decision.risk_assessment: Extremely low volatility and volume across both BTC and ETH. ADX levels below 15 indicate an absence of any clear trend, creating high chop risk.
decision.reasoning: Both BTC and ETH are consolidating in extremely tight Bollinger bands with neutral RSI (~50) and flat moving averages. Without trend confirmation or volume expansion, opening a position poses an unfavorable risk/reward profile. Staying in cash until a directional breakout emerges.
